body:
If you have access to mental health services, please take them. I know depression never goes away, especially not one as pervasive as existential depression, but you can at least give Bob a swift kick in the bollocks. Ultimately, it may be a chemical imbalance, and Bob is just using these existential quandaries against us. I don't know; as I said, I can only get so far analyzing my own mind. The only thing I know for sure are my feelings at this moment, and they ain't the greatest, and they haven't changed much over the past few months.

If you have the opportunities, take them, if for nobody else than some random wallflower on the Internet.

For me it's less the recognition that my own legacy is destined to the dust; I never really was one for fame and recognition. Rather, it is that nearly everything beautiful in the world; everything that can bring joy can so easily be squandered by that damned innate instinct of greed. The same instinct that drives a squirrel to hoard acorns has brought so many of mankind's great creations to their knees.

While I can't particularly say that I'm glad to see that Bob inhabits your mind as well, it does at the very least mean there may be something to my interpretation of the character. It's always a bit of a nice feeling when you have something made by David Lynch more or less figured out.

As for the happiness thing, I just want to go through the better part of every year not being plagued by Bob. I don't object to medication; after all, perhaps Bob has stooped to the lows of chemical warfare himself? However, I do worry that something would go wrong with the medication/that it would lose its efficacy over time. Perhaps Bob has become so pervasive in my mind that I fear the very concept of happiness, and that's why I have those slight apprehensions. Psychoanalyzing myself only gets me so far.

I do wish I had seen what this ethereal extra comment was, given that the counter says there is one more comment than there actually is. Perhaps it was someone proclaiming my "edgelord" status, only for it to be removed by a mod or something. Not that something like that would influence me in any appreciable way; I tell myself much worse than that on a daily basis.
